resumeText:
Meera Kulkarni | Pune | meera.kulkarni@example.com

SUMMARY
Data science leader with 14 years in insurance and retail analytics.

EXPERIENCE
Head of Data Science, Saffron General Insurance, Pune (2020 - present)
- Wrote the AI roadmap and ran AI use case prioritisation with business heads.
- Reviewed supervised learning models for claims fraud and renewal.
- Set up MLflow and model monitoring for 25 production models.
- Led data lineage and data stewardship work with the data office.
- Moved reporting to Snowflake as the main data platform.
- Managed a team of 28 across data science and data engineering.
- Use stakeholder communication with claims, underwriting and sales heads.
- Hired engineers and data scientists for two new teams.

Lead Data Scientist, Indus Retail, Mumbai (2015 - 2020)
- Built demand forecasting models.

Data Analyst, Konkan Infotech, Pune (2012 - 2015)

EDUCATION
MSc Statistics, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2012
